name: Operating expense
definition: Total operating expense for the system in the stated scope. Excludes debt service and depreciation.

name: Vehicle (car) revenue kilometers
definition: Kilometers run by individual cars in revenue service.

name: Train revenue hours
definition: Hours run by trains in revenue service.

name: Trips (boardings)
definition: Passenger boardings. Note whether transfers inside the system count as new trips.

name: Passenger kilometers
definition: Sum of distances traveled by all passengers.

name: Employees (full-time equivalent)
definition: Staff working on the system in the stated scope. Note whether contractors are included.

name: Fare revenue
definition: Passenger fare revenue in the stated scope.

name: Mean distance between failures
definition: Car-km run per mechanical failure that caused a delay or removal from service. Definitions differ by agency; note the definition.

name: Route length
definition: Length of routes in service (not track length).

name: Stations
definition: Number of stations. Note how transfer complexes are counted.

name: Operating expense per car-km
definition: opex_total divided by car_km.

name: Operating expense per passenger-km
definition: opex_total divided by passenger_km.

name: Operating expense per trip
definition: opex_total divided by unlinked_trips.

name: Farebox recovery ratio
definition: fare_revenue divided by opex_total.

name: Operating expense: vehicle operations
definition: NTD function 'Vehicle Operations' (running revenue service). Exact definition: NTD Policy Manual; not yet checked.

name: Operating expense: vehicle maintenance
definition: NTD function 'Vehicle Maintenance' (maintaining the car fleet). Exact definition: NTD Policy Manual; not yet checked.

name: Operating expense: facility maintenance
definition: NTD function 'Facility Maintenance' (fixed assets such as track, signals and stations). Exact definition: NTD Policy Manual; not yet checked.

name: Operating expense: general administration
definition: NTD function 'General Administration', including administrative and overhead costs the reporter allocates to the mode.

name: Operating expense excluding general administration per car-km
definition: (opex_total minus opex_general_administration) divided by car_km. Shows cost without overhead, per the scoping rule.

name: Operating expense per car revenue hour
definition: opex_total divided by car_revenue_hours.

name: Operating expense per operating labor hour
definition: opex_total divided by employee_hours_operating. Not a wage: includes non-labor costs.

name: Vehicle (car) revenue miles
definition: NTD 'Vehicle Revenue Miles' for rail: miles run by individual passenger cars in revenue service. Source unit for car_km.

name: Vehicle (car) revenue hours
definition: NTD 'Vehicle Revenue Hours' for rail: hours run by individual passenger cars in revenue service. Not train hours.

name: Passenger miles
definition: NTD 'Passenger Miles Traveled'. Source unit for passenger_km.

name: Directional route miles
definition: NTD 'Directional Route Miles': route length counted once per direction of travel. Roughly twice the route length.

name: Directional route kilometers
definition: directional_route_miles converted to km.

name: Cars operated in maximum service
definition: NTD 'Vehicles Operated in Maximum Service': cars in service at the peak.

name: Train revenue miles
definition: NTD Breakdowns table 'Train Revenue Miles': miles run by whole trains in revenue service.

name: Train revenue kilometers
definition: train_revenue_miles converted to km.

name: Average trip length
definition: passenger_km divided by unlinked_trips.

name: Average passengers per car
definition: passenger_km divided by car_km: the average number of passengers on board a car in revenue service.

name: Average cars per train
definition: car_km divided by train_km.

name: Major mechanical failures
definition: NTD Breakdowns table, column major_mechanical_failures. Exact definition: NTD Policy Manual; not yet checked. See method ntd_mdbf_major.

name: Other mechanical failures
definition: NTD Breakdowns table, column other_mechanical_failures. Reporting practice varies widely between agencies and years (see method ntd_mdbf_major).

name: Total mechanical failures
definition: Sum of major and other mechanical failures.

name: Operating employees
definition: NTD employee count (full-time plus part-time) in the four operating functions; capital labor excluded. Part-time staff count as one each.

name: Operating labor hours
definition: NTD employee work hours (full-time plus part-time) in the four operating functions; capital labor excluded.

name: Employees: vehicle operations
definition: Full-time plus part-time NTD employee count in vehicle operations.

name: Employees: vehicle maintenance
definition: Full-time plus part-time NTD employee count in vehicle maintenance.

name: Employees: facility maintenance
definition: Full-time plus part-time NTD employee count in facility maintenance.

name: Employees: general administration
definition: Full-time plus part-time NTD employee count in general administration.

name: Employees per million car-km
definition: Staff divided by car_km in millions. US systems use employees_operating; other systems use employees_fte. Main labor-productivity measure.

name: Passenger-km per employee
definition: passenger_km divided by staff (employees_operating for US systems, employees_fte for other systems).

name: Trips per employee
definition: unlinked_trips divided by staff (employees_operating for US systems, employees_fte for other systems).

name: NTD employee count, vehicle operations, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_operations_count, full-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, vehicle operations, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_operations_hours, full-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, vehicle operations, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_operations_count, part-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, vehicle operations, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_operations_hours, part-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, vehicle maintenance, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_maintenance_count, full-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, vehicle maintenance, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_maintenance_hours, full-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, vehicle maintenance, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_maintenance_count, part-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, vehicle maintenance, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column vehicle_maintenance_hours, part-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, facility maintenance, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column facility_maintenance_count, full-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, facility maintenance, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column facility_maintenance_hours, full-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, facility maintenance, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column facility_maintenance_count, part-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, facility maintenance, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column facility_maintenance_hours, part-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, general administration, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column general_administration_count, full-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, general administration, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column general_administration_hours, full-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, general administration, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column general_administration_count, part-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, general administration, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column general_administration_hours, part-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, capital labor, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column capital_labor_count, full-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, capital labor, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column capital_labor_hours, full-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, capital labor, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column capital_labor_count, part-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, capital labor, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column capital_labor_hours, part-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, total, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column total_employee_count, full-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, total, full-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column total_hours, full-time rows).

name: NTD employee count, total, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column total_employee_count, part-time rows). Some agencies report fractional values.

name: NTD employee work hours, total, part-time
definition: As published in the NTD Employees table (column total_hours, part-time rows).

name: Operating expense per train-km
definition: opex_total divided by train_km.

name: Operating expense: direct
definition: Operating cost the agency books directly to the metro business (operations, maintenance, stations), before allocated central overhead. Excludes depreciation, capital renewals and interest unless stated.

name: Operating expense: allocated indirect cost
definition: Central or indirect operating cost the agency allocates to the metro business (similar in role to NTD general administration).

name: Cars in fleet
definition: Number of passenger cars owned (fleet size), not cars in service.

name: Operating revenue
definition: Total revenue from operations (net sales) in the stated scope, including any payments from government for service if the source does not separate them.

name: Operating expense by object class: operators' wages
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column operators_wages. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: other salaries and wages
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column other_salaries_wages. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: operators' paid absences
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column operator_paid_absences. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: other paid absences
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column other_paid_absences. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: fringe benefits
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column fringe_benefits. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: services
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column services. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: fuel and lubricants
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column fuel_and_lube. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: tires
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column tires. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: other materials and supplies
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column other_materials_supplies. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: utilities
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column utilities. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: casualty and liability
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column casualty_and_liability. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: taxes
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column taxes. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: purchased transportation
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column purchased_transportation. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense by object class: miscellaneous
definition: NTD Operating Expenses by Type, column miscellaneous. Object classes sum to opex_total.

name: Operating expense including depreciation
definition: Operating expense as published when the source includes depreciation (for example MLIT 営業費計). Used only to derive opex_total.

name: Depreciation and amortisation
definition: Depreciation charged to operating expense in the stated scope.

name: Employees of the operating company only (headcount)
definition: Staff of the operating company itself in the stated segment, excluding subsidiaries. Shown next to employees_fte where a group figure is used.

name: Operating subsidy from government
definition: Government money received for operating purposes in the stated scope (not capital grants). Say in notes what it pays for; some of it services past debt.

name: Operating expense: staff costs
definition: Staff costs and related expenses (wages, benefits, pension) inside opex_total, as the source publishes them.

name: Operating expense of businesses outside the metro
definition: Costs the source reports for activities that are not running the metro (for example construction or operation done under contract for others). Used to remove them from a whole-agency total.

name: Operating revenue
definition: All operating revenue of the stated scope (fares, other transport income and, where stated, government payments for services).

name: Earnings before interest and tax
definition: Operating profit as the source reports it.
